# AWS `dev` config manifest (Sprint 20 Story 03)

Source of truth for classification and cloud defaults. Cross-checked against
[`DEPLOY_AWS_DEV.md` §6](../../DEPLOY_AWS_DEV.md), `dating-api/.env.example`,
and `dating-ui/.env.example`.

Terraform: [`../terraform/modules/secrets/`](../terraform/modules/secrets/).
Non-secret placeholders: [`dev.tfvars.example`](./dev.tfvars.example).

**Never commit real secret values.** Rotation of any injected secret/param requires an **ECS task redeploy** (force new deployment). Changing any `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` requires a **UI image rebuild** (Story 04), not only a task restart.

---

## Classification summary

| Kind | Store | Injected how |
|------|-------|--------------|
| **Secret** | AWS Secrets Manager | ECS task `secrets` → container env |
| **Config** | SSM Parameter Store `String` | ECS task `secrets` (preferred) or `environment` |
| **UI build-time** | SSM `/dating/dev/ui/build/*` (for CI) | Docker `--build-arg` at image build — **not** API/UI task def for `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` |
| **Unset in cloud** | — | Must not appear in SSM/task def |

---

## Secrets (Secrets Manager)

| Env var | Required at boot | Notes |
|---------|------------------|-------|
| `DATABASE_URL` | **Yes** | Prefer Story 02 RDS secret JSON key `database_url` (`…:database_url::`). SSL: `sslmode=require`. Pool: `connection_limit=10&pool_timeout=10` (see `dating-api/docs/ops/PRISMA_CONNECTION_POOL.md`). |
| `OPENAI_API_KEY` | **Yes** | Boot blocker (L5). Set via CLI / `TF_VAR_openai_api_key`. |
| `SESSION_SECRET_PEPPER` | **Yes** | Auto-generated by Terraform (`random_password`) unless disabled. ≥32 chars. |
| `RESEND_API_KEY` | When email enabled | Shell always created; set value when `EMAIL_PROVIDER=resend`. |
| `PHOTO_CDN_PRIVATE_KEY` | When CDN enabled | **Preserve `\n` escapes as a single-line secret.** |
| `SENTRY_DSN` | Recommended | Optional locally; set in cloud if using Sentry. |
| `DD_API_KEY` | When Datadog on | Pair with `DD_TRACE_ENABLED=1`. |
| `EMAIL_UNSUBSCRIBE_SECRET` | When email on | Auto-generated by Terraform by default. |
| `PRODUCT_ANALYTICS_HASH_SALT` | Optional | From `.env.example`; secret shell created; set via CLI if used. |

## Intentionally unset in cloud

| Env var | Why |
|---------|-----|
| `PHOTO_MODERATION_AUTO_APPROVE` | Local/dev escape hatch only — **do not create** this SSM param. |
| `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID` / `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` | Use ECS task role; leave unset. |
| `PHOTO_UPLOAD_DIR` | Local driver only. |

## UI — build-time vs runtime

From `dating-ui/.env.example` + `DEPLOY_AWS_DEV.md` §6.2.

### Baked at image build (`NEXT_PUBLIC_*` and related)

Changing these requires **rebuild + redeploy** of the UI image (Story 04 CI). They are **not** API ECS task secrets.

| Var | Role | Suggested cloud value |
|-----|------|------------------------|
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID` | GIS client ID (must match API `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID`) | same as API |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL` | Browser API origin | **Leave unset** for same-origin + rewrites (recommended) |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_SESSION_COOKIE_NAME` | Cookie name if non-default | `dating_session` |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_REALTIME` | `ws` \| `poll` | `ws` |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_PORT` | Fallback API port when API URL unset | usually omit in cloud |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_AUTH_TEST` | Dev-only test routes | **omit** |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_ADMIN_ENABLED` | Gate `/admin` in prod builds | `0` unless network-gated admin host |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_MATCH_QUALITY_RUNBOOK_URL` | Optional admin link | omit or ops URL |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN` | Browser Sentry | optional |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_ENVIRONMENT` | Sentry env label | `dev` |

Published for CI under SSM path `/dating/dev/ui/build/<KEY>`.

### Server-side / runtime (UI container or build)

| Var | When | Notes |
|-----|------|-------|
| `API_PROXY_TARGET` | Same-origin rewrite target | e.g. `http://dating-api.internal:3001` |
| `INTERNAL_API_URL` | SSR server-side calls | same internal URL |
| `SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN` / `SENTRY_ORG` / `SENTRY_PROJECT` | **CI build only** (source maps) | Never in repo; CI secret store — not ECS task |

`API_PROXY_TARGET` is read by `next.config.ts` at **build** time for rewrites — treat as build-arg in Story 04 unless the UI image is built with a runtime entry that re-reads env (today: build-time).

## Least-privilege IAM

Module attaches policy allowing the ECS **execution** role to:

- `ssm:GetParameter(s)` / `GetParametersByPath` on exactly the API SSM ARNs this module creates
- `secretsmanager:GetSecretValue` / `DescribeSecret` on exactly the app secret ARNs (+ Story 02 RDS secret ARN when wired)

Task **role** (app AWS API calls for S3/Rekognition) is Story 02 IAM — separate from secret injection.

---

## Operator runbook (set secrets)

```bash
# After terraform apply of modules/secrets:
aws secretsmanager put-secret-value --secret-id "$OPENAI_SECRET_ARN" --secret-string "$OPENAI_API_KEY"

# CDN private key — single line with \n escapes
aws secretsmanager put-secret-value --secret-id "$CDN_KEY_ARN" \
  --secret-string '-----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY-----\n...\n-----END RSA PRIVATE KEY-----'

# Then force new deployment so tasks pick up values
aws ecs update-service --cluster dating-dev --service dating-api --force-new-deployment
```
